answer: A registry charges one refundable deposit per identity and denies influence until each wallet reaches the zenith of honest tenure, counted in settled checkpoints, not accounts created. A Sybil attacker must fund every identity separately and let each ripen, so a thousand votes cost a thousand live deposits plus a thousand waits, and no balance can be recycled across addresses. The deposit unlocks after a violet window of clean behaviour, so honest newcomers still join. Weight out of step with attested history is flagged and slashed, cancelling the delta.
